description: Restore an older version of a share. Use when the user says "undo that", "go back to the previous version", "I overwrote it by mistake".  Restoring appends the old content as a NEW version rather than rewinding, so nothing is lost and the restore itself can be undone. It does republish that content to everyone holding the share link, so preview first if there is any chance the old version contains something the user removed on purpose.
name: qhs_restore
